tableLines.line: 👂 Overheard — Thabo (to Márcia): "Leo's story has a fresh coat of paint." Thabo taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Portland, Oregon. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Hayden speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~970 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🥣 Dmitri of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Ashford. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
Dmitri waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

📓 Codex: Cole of The Red Table raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Cole of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.

Fresh-cut stems on the southeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The southeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)

scaleLines.line: Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

🧳 Word of Haven’s new bindings, the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Ashford and Emberhold have bound together — Ashford primary. Other fires are climbing, too.

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."

👑 Speakers from Thornfield, Ashford, Emberhold ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less).
